metaTitle: Custom Golf Towels with Carabiner | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom golf towels with carabiner for easy attachment to golf bags. Perfect for corporate events and tournaments.
introHtml: Golf towels with a carabiner clip offer a simple, practical upgrade: they hook directly onto a golf bag loop, keeping the towel accessible without fumbling. Whether you choose a classic Champions towel or a waffle-weave style for extra absorbency, the carabiner ensures the towel stays put during play. This makes them a smart giveaway for corporate golf outings, charity tournaments, or any event where convenience matters.
heroAltText: Custom golf towels with carabiner clip attached to golf bag, featuring embroidered logo
